changes: calibration diagnostics are descriptive: a normal-approximation interval for the mean target probability, multiclass Brier and log loss, and selected-answer reliability bins
record the repeated-prompt limitation (12 distinct request hashes, not 17 independent prompts) and rename effective_independent_prompts to distinct_request_hashes
amendment.reason: the locked v1 named a Wilson interval for p_correct, but p_correct is defined as the mean probability assigned to the true target, to which Wilson does not apply; and the 17 instances are repeated queries, not independent prompts

approved_decisions: Jev Choice capability/calibration probe: 17 held-out planning-low instances x ISO/FULL
68 physical requests maximum, including retries; $1 cost cap
pinned jev-1.13.0 at the TypeSafe System One endpoint

calibration_diagnostics.brier_multiclass: mean over the 17 FULL cases of sum_i (p_i - 1{option_i == target})^2; a missing or invalid case scores 1.0
calibration_diagnostics.footnote: 17 held-out instances is a small probe; reliability bins are descriptive and do not establish calibration
calibration_diagnostics.log_loss_multiclass: mean over the 17 FULL cases of -log(p_target); a missing or invalid case scores -log(1e-12)
calibration_diagnostics.p_correct_definition: mean probability assigned to the true target over the 17 FULL cases; a missing or invalid FULL case counts as 0.0
calibration_diagnostics.repeated_prompt_limitation: the 17 instances yield only 12 distinct request hashes (6 ISO/FULL prompt pairs) and 10 of 34 requests match the earlier wire smoke; these are repeated queries, not independent prompts, so no calibration is established and Wilson intervals must not be read as 17 independent prompts
calibration_diagnostics.scope: descriptive only; this probe cannot establish calibration
calibration_diagnostics.selected_answer_reliability: descriptive bins of the selected-option probability against checker correctness; separate from target calibration
calibration_diagnostics.uncertainty: normal-approximation interval for the mean target probability; Wilson does not apply to a mean probability

capability_metrics.full_vector_validity: share of attempted cases returning the documented Choice envelope with an exact option-key set and finite in-range probabilities
capability_metrics.iso_mass_on_consistent_set: descriptive: ISO probability mass on the private clue-consistent candidate set
capability_metrics.normalization: probability sum within the codec normalization tolerance
capability_metrics.option_identity: criteria keys equal the exact sorted public candidate ids and the answer probability keys equal them
capability_metrics.scope: capability only; these are not calibration estimates
capability_metrics.task_validity_full: FULL-selected option accepted by the checker on instances whose pooled clues determine a unique target, over the fixed 17 FULL denominator; a missing or invalid FULL output counts as a failure

frozen_settings.instructions: Using the clues in `state`, assess how well each candidate in `criteria` fits those clues. Return a probability for every candidate in `criteria`.

continue_if: task_validity_full >= 0.9 (>= 16/17 FULL cases accepted, missing/invalid counted as failures)
go_no_go.denominator: all 17 FULL cases must be attempted; a missing or invalid FULL output counts as a failure
go_no_go.note: a repeated-query capability check: a passing probe does not establish calibration and does not authorize #157
stop_if: resolved model differs from the pinned model
go_no_go.task_validity_full_definition: checker-accepted FULL selections divided by the 17 attempted FULL cases; missing or invalid FULL outputs count as failures

held_out.note: J3 capability block (seed base 71000) is disjoint from the wire smoke and the frozen planning-low manifest; J5 must use a further disjoint block

protocol_boundary.note: Jev artifacts are keyed by the additive Jev protocol key and must not be pooled with Ling artifacts or the offline scaffold; the analysis loader refuses mixed keys

provider_settings.instructions: Using the clues in `state`, assess how well each candidate in `criteria` fits those clues. Return a probability for every candidate in `criteria`.
